spans.text: [2] AR: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ EN: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.
There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

[18] AR: شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًۢا بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ EN: Allah witnesses that there is no deity except Him, and [so do] the angels and those of knowledge - [that He is] maintaining [creation] in justice.
There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

spans.text: [7] AR: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِنْهُ ءَايَٰتٌۭ مُّحْكَمَٰتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَٰبِهَٰتٌۭ ۖ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌۭ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَٰبَهَ مِنْهُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ ٱلْفِتْنَةِ وَٱبْتِغَآءَ تَأْوِيلِهِۦ ۗ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱلرَّٰسِخُونَ فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ يَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ كُلٌّۭ مِّنْ عِندِ رَبِّنَا ۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ EN: It is He who has sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Book; in it are verses [that are] precise - they are the foundation of the Book - and others unspecific.

folded.id: never|will|their wealth or their children avail them against allah at all
folded.subject: never
folded.object: their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all

spans.text: [10] AR: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ وَقُودُ ٱلنَّارِ EN: Indeed, those who disbelieve - never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all.

folded.id: no one|will|be reminded except those of understanding
folded.subject: no one
folded.object: be reminded except those of understanding

spans.text: And no one will be reminded except those of understanding.

folded.id: of allah|is|islam
folded.subject: of Allah

spans.text: [19] AR: إِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْإِسْلَٰمُ ۗ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ EN: Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam.

folded.id: of allah|will|have a severe punishment
folded.subject: of Allah

spans.text: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the verses of Allah will have a severe punishment, and Allah is exalted in Might, the Owner of Retribution.

folded.id: so allah|seized|them for their sins
folded.subject: so Allah

spans.text: They denied Our signs, so Allah seized them for their sins.

folded.id: surely you|will|gather the people for a day about which there is no doubt
folded.subject: surely You
folded.object: gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt

spans.text: [9] AR: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍۢ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ EN: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt.

folded.id: that|is|the enjoyment of worldly life
folded.subject: That

spans.text: That is the enjoyment of worldly life, but Allah has with Him the best return.

folded.id: the scripture|did|not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves
folded.subject: the Scripture
folded.object: not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves

spans.text: And those who were given the Scripture did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves.

folded.id: there|is|no deity except him
folded.subject: there

spans.text: [2] AR: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ EN: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.
There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

[18] AR: شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًۢا بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ EN: Allah witnesses that there is no deity except Him, and [so do] the angels and those of knowledge - [that He is] maintaining [creation] in justice.
There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

folded.id: they|will|follow that of it which is unspecific
folded.subject: they
folded.object: follow that of it which is unspecific

spans.text: As for those in whose hearts is deviation [from truth], they will follow that of it which is unspecific, seeking discord and seeking an interpretation [suitable to them].

folded.id: upon you|is|only the [duty of] notification
folded.subject: upon you

spans.text: And if they submit [in Islam], they are rightly guided; but if they turn away - then upon you is only the [duty of] notification.

folded.id: whose hearts|is|deviation [from truth]
folded.subject: whose hearts

spans.text: As for those in whose hearts is deviation [from truth], they will follow that of it which is unspecific, seeking discord and seeking an interpretation [suitable to them].

folded.id: you|will|be overcome and gathered together to hell
folded.subject: You
folded.object: be overcome and gathered together to Hell

spans.text: [12] AR: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَتُغْلَبُونَ وَتُحْشَرُونَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ EN: Say to those who disbelieve, "You will be overcome and gathered together to Hell, and wretched is the resting place."
